lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path new_flow, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, home notification, and sign_in hint, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, home wait_info across 2 tests, or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test showing no clear effect and another causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for minor tweaks while severely underestimating major positive wins like the adoption redesign.

candidates.title: Adoption Companion Archetype Studio
candidates.change: Redesign the pet friend picker into a character archetype stage layout with animated trait callouts and dynamic previews before final adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption redesign was confirmed statistically significant in round 3, and adoption still loses nearly 30% of users with high mean time (1017s). Support also noted user feedback on custom pet failures.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Onboarding Goal Selector Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an intent goal selection screen prior to path selection, letting users define whether their pet is for productivity, entertainment, or focus.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with high mean duration (514s). Defining the companion's primary role upfront aligns user expectations early.

new_goal_selection.headline: What is your companion's main mission?
new_goal_selection.body: Select how your desktop pet will assist you daily.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an intent goal selection screen within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: choose_path new_flow previously produced a -0.7% drop with thin evidence and requires a new flow.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Sandbox Screen
candidates.change: Add a hands-on sandbox screen at the finish step where users practice dragging, toggling visibility, and interacting with their pet before desktop deployment.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding, while finish conversion sits at only 64.8%.

new_interaction_sandbox.headline: Try Your Pet Controls
new_interaction_sandbox.body: Practice moving your pet around and accessing command shortcuts right here.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interaction sandbox screen following home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%), clear support feedback, and past finish new_screen showed +3.3% lift.

candidates.title: Async Generation Mini Game Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive waiting room mini-game sub-screen during pet rendering so users remain active while waiting for desktop setup.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s. Active engagement prevents drop-off and frustration during long background tasks.

new_waiting_minigame.headline: Play While Your Pet Prepares
new_waiting_minigame.body: Interact with toy elements while your custom pet renders in the background.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interactive waiting room screen during rendering.

candidates.score_note: High wait time at home, but home new_flow previously resulted in a -3.7% drop and requires high effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Readiness Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home intro into a two-column readiness hub showing shortcuts, system tray locations, and quick toggle keys.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple post-onboarding queries regarding pet controls and system tray location, and finish step conversion is lowest at 64.8%.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home_intro onboarding screen into a readiness hub.

candidates.score_note: Finish has largest drop-off and strong support evidence, but finish redesign severely degraded conversion (-6.1%) previously.

candidates.title: Account Session Protection Hint
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data from being lost upon app updates or reboots.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets (the largest single category) reported pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your companion data permanently to prevent pet progress loss on restart.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an informative sign-in hint explaining session protection.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 tickets), but sign_in hint previously yielded -0.7% with no clear positive effect.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert a photo quality check screen that validates lighting and crop before custom pet creation starts.
candidates.why: Support received emails regarding custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during adoption.

new_photo_checker.headline: Photo Clarity Check
new_photo_checker.body: We check lighting and background to make sure your custom pet generates perfectly.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a photo quality check screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 29.9% adoption drop-off with support tickets; adoption new_screen previously saw +2.5% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Audio Readiness Cue
candidates.change: Enable system alerts and an audio notification chime when background pet rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Support reported issues with pets not displaying or users missing when background processing finishes after long delays.

guard.reason: Valid addition of audio readiness cue and notification settings to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses background wait frustration, but notification changes showed negative/neutral results (-0.4%).

candidates.title: Spotlight Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode, displaying path benefits one featured card at a time.
candidates.why: 23.8% drop off at choose_path with a 514s mean time, showing decision fatigue across available options.

guard.reason: Valid layout update to the path selection screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets 23.8% drop-off and 514s delay at choose_path; layout tweak carries moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Cloud Save Companion Accessory Reward
candidates.change: Add an exclusive cosmetic accessory badge component to the sign-in screen granted upon account linkage.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, and account save issues are the top user concern in support logs.

components.text: Unlocks Exclusive Cloud Saved Crown Accessory

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras by offering an exclusive accessory reward for signing in.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish redesign, and home new_flow, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy, home wait_info, sign_in reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, or sign_in hint across multiple tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for minor tweaks while severely underestimating major positive wins like the adoption redesign.
